chapter: Later life, Terry Gibbs and Artie Shaw
title: Burning out after eight years and settling in Panama City
summary: After eight years he crashed, slept for weeks, and moved to Florida.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: It took its toll, after eight years, I crashed after that. Joyce and I moved here, in this area, Panama City. Not far from here.
And last night Joyce said you spent, how long, a month and a half sleeping thirteen, fourteen hours.
Maybe longer, sleeping! All day long. I tried to recoup, and finally I got back to my normal ten hours sleep the night. [laughter]
Yeah, or a day…I still do. I sleep about nine or ten hours.
Yeah, plus a nap sometimes in the afternoon.
